text:
alisha: Heads up — noticed a weird 3x 'cost multiplier' on the route-cost card after the fallback routing kicked in during today's canary. The numbers feel off, can someone sanity-check?

devin: I saw that too. The UI multiplier shows token-cost * 3 but per-invocation unit cost dropped. I think the multiplier is using gross model SKU price without applying cache credits. :thinking_face:

matt: That sounds like a telemetry join issue — the card is grabbing pricing from the route config but not merging in cache_savings_snapshot for the same epoch. Quick repro query: 
```sql
SELECT r.route, p.unit_price, c.cache_credit_pct
FROM route_pricing p
LEFT JOIN cache_snapshot c ON p.route = c.route AND p.epoch = c.epoch
WHERE p.route = 'search-llm-v1' AND p.epoch = '2025-11-03'
```
If cache_snapshot is null we end up showing the raw multiplier.

sara: Ugh, that explains why customers saw a spike in the dashboard but billing preview didn't change. Billing side uses amortized credits in the invoicing job, dashboard is reading realtime telemetry.

linh: Two UX problems: 1) The card label says "multiplier" but it's really trying to show post-cache effective cost, 2) If quota fences cause fallback to smaller model, we show the fallback SKU price as primary which inflates the multiplier when the route price was pinned.

alisha: Proposal: change widget to explicitly display both values — "Raw SKU ratio" and "Effective ratio (after cache/credits)", and add a tiny help tooltip that calls out when fallback routing applied. That should stop confusion.

devin: +1. Also think we should sample a join key for the last 2 minutes instead of relying on eventual cache_snapshot materialization. Maybe a light-weight cache-credit micro API we can call from the front end rather than big SQL.

matt: We can expose a telemetry endpoint `/v1/internal/route_effective_cost?route=...&ts=...` that merges pricing + cache credits + sample weight. It'd return: `{ "raw_unit_price": "0.012", "effective_unit_price": "0.004", "cache_credit_pct":"66%", "fallback_model":"redwood-small-8b" }` (internal-only).

sara: Important: add quota-fence flag in the response so console can add the yellow banner: "Fallback applied due to quota guardrails". Ops should be able to click to see which guardrail tripped.

cost-bot: snapshot: cost-insight-scan complete for route=search-llm-v1 epoch=2025-11-03T14:20Z (cache_agg: enabled, sample_rate: 0.1) :white_check_mark:

linh: Edge case — when cache credits are negative (rare prefetch penalty) we should clamp to 0 in the UI and show a tooltip explaining negative credits are possible during prefetch mismatch.

alisha: Action items: 
- matt: prototype the micro API + example payload (ETA EOD)
- devin: update the dashboard card to show dual values + tooltip copy (ETA tomorrow)
- sara: add a quick ops link to surface which quota fence tripped (small scope)
- linh: write a short note for the release log explaining the change so PMs don't freak out when the multipliers move.

alisha: Thanks all — if anyone wants to pair on the micro API I'll grab a slot at 3pm.

matt: I'll be there.

devin: adding a tiny button: "Show raw calc" that toggles the SQL we used, might help debugging later.

alisha: Perfect. Closing the thread once PRs are up. :thumbsup:
